candidates: src/sentry/integrations/services/assignment_source.py:18 - `queued` default is evaluated once at import time, so every instance gets the same timestamp.. `queued: datetime = timezone.now()` runs once, when the class is defined. Every `AssignmentSource` built without an explicit `queued` (including every one from `from_integration`) then carries the worker's import time, not the time it was queued.
